newsitem.title: USA: Fla. 518 MW Northside power unit now seen up Wed.
newsitem.headline: Fla. 518 MW Northside power unit now seen up Wed.

text.p: Restart of the 518 megawatt (MW) power unit at the Northside generating complex in Jacksonville, Fla., was pushed back to Wednesday as more time was needed to complete its seasonal maintenance, the operator said Tuesday.
"We should have the unit back Wednesday afternoon," said a spokesman for Jacksonville Electric Authority.
Northside's unit 3, which was shut earlier this month, was previously planned to resume operation Monday. The unit consumes natural gas to produce electricity.
The entire Northside facility has a rated capacity of 1,231 MW.
